message: 色々おっきな妹さん

name: Ria
message: 「Ta-da! This is my beloved ride♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, don't tell me you actually have a driver's license!?」

name: Misa
message: 「As expected of you, Big Sister...\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「A rear car, just for Ria. Just kidding\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, shall we head to the shopping district?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's go!」
We all wheel Senior Ria's cart along together.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, we're here!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So we simply have them offer up their unwanted items as tribute right away!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Not quite, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then, is it a sacred offering?」

name: Ria
message: 「Wrong again. We're asking the folks in the shopping district to donate things we can sell at the Charity Bazaar.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoho~」

name: Ria
message: 「What's written in that guidebook isn't everything, so you've gotta be careful」

name: Lolotte
message: 「*Flinch.* H-How did you know?」

name: Ria
message: 「'Heh. I can see right through everything about you...'」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, Sister, you really are so kind. Going out of your way to explain it so thoroughly」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Lolotte is a returnee after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't think that excuses everything!!」

name: Misa
message: 「To begin with, Lolotte-san, it's been quite a while since you moved here, hasn't it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even Azel wouldn't make a mistake like that, probably」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then let us have them offer tribute! This is correct, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's having them make donations, Lolotte-chan. That's what a Charity Bazaar is」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see~! That wasn't listed in here」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha, that's a weird book.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「After all, the word 'impossible' isn't even in it.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's all you wanted to say, isn't it? So, where might we be paying a visit?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai, please stop keeping us in suspense and tell us.」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm not the one who decides that\s07」

name: Misa
message: 「Gasp!? Onee-sama is counting on me!?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's me, isn't it?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Sakura-kun!! Don't you think there's a limit to how full of yourself you can be!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, do you have a good idea, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Eek! W-Well, that's... um...」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now, Synn-kun. Did you already forget what Misa-chan just said?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「When she asked, 'Where might we be paying a visit?' she was asking you, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Me? I thought for sure she was asking you, Senpai...」

name: Misa
message: 「*Gulp*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The two of you rely on Senpai way too much! How pathetic, honestly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmph... Being called pathetic by Nanaka of all people really stings.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, what's that supposed to mean!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaalright! Let's start collecting unwanted items!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, yeah, that's the spirit♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thank you very much!」
From items inside shops to whatever surplus goods households have lying around, we'll take it all off their hands.

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, let's save Tame-san's place for later.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gotcha!」

name: Synn
message: 「Next is--」

name: Ria
message: 「Whoa~~. I didn't know there was a shop like this. You sure know your way around, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Nanaka and I practically grew up here, after all」

name: Ria
message: 「Even though I've lived in Ryuusei Town my whole life, too~」

name: Synn
message: 「You only ever come here to go shopping, right, Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, it's a shopping district... right? What else would you come here to do besides shop?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha. That's the fundamental difference right there. For us, this place is our everyday living space」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We used to hang out and play here a lot, too」

name: Synn
message: 「Some people even come here on dates, you know」

name: Ria
message: 「Is that so~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Every day brings new discoveries. Why don't you try going on a date here with your sweetheart sometime, Senpai-san?」

name: Everyone
message: 「Ehh!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When one speaks of a young lady from a good family, arranged marriages come to mind. It's only natural for her to have a fiance or two--some young master from somewhere」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Well, that's... um...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't tell me you don't have anyone to go on a date with? Someone of your stature, Senpai-san?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I-If you put it like that... umm...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on a second. Does that mean you have a fiance too, Loro-chan?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Do I look like I do?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nope, not at all!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How rude! Just what do you think I look like, then!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「An angel」

name: Lolotte
message: 「W-Wha!? I am not!?」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So, Senpai. What's the real story here...」

name: Misa
message: 「It's a lie, isn't it! Please tell me it's a lie, Sister!」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's... um, well...」

name: Ria
message: 「And how about you, Misa-chan?」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm just, um... even putting me in the same league as you, Big Sister, would be presumptuous--I'm just a commoner, a plebeian, no, no, a mere peasant!」

name: Misa
message: 「Besides, this heart of mine is already... completely filled with a certain esteemed person...\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「D-Don't tell me... Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「*Gulp*」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, do you have a fiancee or not?! Tell me, Senpai!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't bring the conversation back to that~~\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「If things stay like this, I'll be too curious to even sleep at night」

name: Ria
message: 「Why do you care so much, Synn!!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that's...\s03」

name: Misa
message: 「Who cares about how Sakura feels! Senpai, please tell me!」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez~! It's a secret!」
Wh-Which one is it~~.

name: Lolotte
message: 「He's not here, is he」

name: Ria
message: 「*Flinch*」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You never know until you try」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, Lolotte!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then why did they want to hide it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's what you call Ria-chan's pride as a young lady... Ria-chan is the best!」

name: Ria
message: 「No!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Waaah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Phew, that scared me\s10」

name: Misa
message: 「I believed in you the whole time, you know」
Even as we say that, everyone lets out a sigh of relief all at once.

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez! I was just praising Synn-kun, though」

name: Ria
message: 「Because he knows so many shops that I don't」

name: Synn
message: 「You know plenty of things that we don't either, Senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's not true」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan too. You guys are people from a whole different world than us」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, yes. Not an angel, a human being」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wait, a different world?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey! Why am I not included in that group?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because you're one of the common rabble, Vice President」

name: Misa
message: 「Grrrr!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Come on, Synn-kun. What kind of shop are you going to show me next?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah, right! Well then, let's head to the next one!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Hold on a second, Synn-chan!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Auntie Shinagawa. Your husband gave me an SLR camera earlier--are you sure it's okay for me to have it?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Never mind about that! What's the deal with this gorgeous lady?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She's pointing at Senpai, though」

name: Ria
message: 「Nice to meet you. My name is Ria Kujou, a third-year at Ryuusei Academy」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Well, I'll be! Getting such a polite greeting from a girl these days. What a well-mannered young lady you are. I'm Reiko Shinagawa」

name: Nanaka
message: 「After all, she is a genuine young lady」

name: Ria
message: 「Come on, Nanaka!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Even I'm a 'young lady' in name at least-wait, Kujou-san, you're the one from the academy!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yes. Thank you very much for your cooperation with the Ryuusei Academy Charity Bazaar on this occasion」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Hey, cut it out. We're just giving away trash here.」

name: Synn
message: 「This camera looks expensive, doesn't it?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「I'd love to donate some of the goods from our shop, you know. Though keeping them fresh all the way until the day of the event is pretty tough」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What is it that you sell?」

name: Synn
message: 「Shinagawa Produce--it's a greengrocer's, so we sell things like vegetables and fruit」

name: Ria
message: 「Then how about setting up a stall on the day of the event, like at a market?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「You sure know how to talk, little miss! Well, if it's that kind of event, we'd be more than happy to take part」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Still, though--」
My aunt looked back and forth between me and Ria-senpai.

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Synn-chan sure has grown into quite the lady-killer, hasn't he」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Even though he already has Nanaka-chan」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「To think this Ria-chan is Synn-chan's 'this'」

name: Ria
message: 「Ehhh!?」
My aunt held up her pinky finger.

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--! What are you talking about--!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Don't be shy, don't be shy. Whoops, I can't just stand around like this.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Auntie, hold on a second!!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「I get that you don't want to admit it, but this is my life's work, so don't get in my way!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not like that--geez! Senpai, help me stop her too!」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh, eh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Auntie is an evangelist of truth. Once it gets past her lips, baseless rumors will spread through the shopping district--no, the whole town. In the blink of an eye!」

name: Ria
message: 「Eeeh!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's why, if we don't stop her fast, it'll be a disaster」
Ria-senpai turned her gaze toward me. She's in trouble. I have to do something.

name: Synn
message: 「Anyway, lying is wrong!! Because this isn't the truth!」

name: Ria
message: 「Reiko-san! You're mistaken, so please reconsider!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「You and my husband are about the only ones who call me that. If it's a joke, hurry up and say so」
Joke or not, you just jumped to conclusions on your own, though.

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Good for you, Nanaka-chan」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gaaah!! It is NOT good!!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Us downtown folks can be a bit clumsy! Come visit again, you're always welcome」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-thank you very much...\s02」
The lady headed back to her shop excitedly, just like a child who'd gotten a new toy.

name: Ria
message: 「Hah... That surprised me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Your soul's practically leaking out of your mouth too, Vice President」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm the one who was surprised. Senpai, if it wasn't true, you should've denied it with everything you had from the start」

name: Ria
message: 「Even if you say that... H-hey, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... Well, when you flat-out reject it like that... it hurts a little」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Feeling a little sad?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm... so sad...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't it the other way around!? Ria-senpai being my girlfriend is way too unreal!!」
Sure, becoming lovers with Ria-senpai sounds like a dream come true, but...

name: Misa
message: 「It's a pipe dream!! Pure fantasy!! It's an issue way before even feeling sad about it!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, you're all going too far! Saying things like that is mean to Synn, you know」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then that means the President, as a representative of the commoners, also has no small chance, does it not?」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh!? Th-That's... well...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't worry. Ria-chan is head over heels for yours truly」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're making things confusing! Shut up!」

name: Ria
message: 「I... I'm really not as much of a proper lady as everyone thinks!」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm bad at table manners, dresses are just fine feathers making fine birds on me, and I even sneak bites of my bento during breaks when I get hungry...」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides... ugh...\s03」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah... Senpai, um... I'm sorry」

name: Misa
message: 「All of those things together are part of your charm, Onee-sama...\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Anyway! We haven't even finished collecting the unwanted items yet, so no slacking off and chatting! Got it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah. You're the president, so take proper charge」

name: Synn
message: 「Weren't you the one making the biggest fuss, Nanaka?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Our treasurer was particularly desperate, weren't you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now then, next up, let's go to Ponpoko!!」
She brushed it off.
Pulling ourselves together, we head to the next shop. Speaking of unwanted items, that calls for a thrift shop.
We make our way to our usual hangout, "Ponpoko," run by Tamekage-san.

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Tame-san~」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Hey, welcome. I just got a shipment of something called facial spray, y'know」

name: Synn
message: 「That sounds interesting, but I'm actually here for something else today--」

name: Tame-san
message: 「I gotcha. This time of year, it's gotta be the bazaar, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Leave it to you, Tame-san. You catch on quick」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Alright, comin' right up. Come over here」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It seems the two of you are quite close」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn's a regular here. Both Tame-san and Synn love collecting junk」

name: Ria
message: 「Is that so~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Everyone. Give me a hand carrying this」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Hey, Synn. There's a newcomer here, so at least introduce us」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, sorry. Let's see, this is--」

name: Ria
message: 「Hello. Nice to meet you, I'm Ria Kujou♪」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Synn's junior? She looks just like a little sister, hahaha」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Little sister?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did you have one?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no! Ria-senpai is my senpai, so......」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Senpai? Which means...... whoops, my bad!」

name: Tame-san
message: 「My bad, my bad. All you young'uns just look so fresh-faced to me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, give me a break. Flattery like that won't work on us.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Gah. Sharp-tongued as ever, missy.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, to an older gentleman, a one- or two-year age gap is basically nothing anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, treating my upperclassman like my little sister...」
Still, if Senpai really were my little sister or something...

name: Ria
message: 「Big brother. The bath is ready. Want me to wash your back for you?」

name: Ria
message: 「I had a scary dream earlier... So, can I sleep with you tonight?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, did you know? Actually, you and I aren't real brother and sister--」
No, no, no! So we really aren't related by blood-wait, that's not it!

name: Ria
message: 「Mmph~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Ria
message: 「You were just thinking about what it'd be like if I were your little sister, weren't you」

name: Synn
message: 「*Gulp*. I-I was not... Ahaha\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, you're such an open book\s09」

name: Synn
message: 「Ow」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmph. I know I don't look older than you anyway, bleh」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, I didn't say anything」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm your junior, I'm your little sister」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, cheer up already~」

name: Ria
message: 「Wh--I'm not even mad!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure you aren't. You're practically pouting right now」

name: Synn
message: 「You're my senior, so if you don't act a little more mature, people are just going to mistake you for being younger again--」

name: Ria
message: 「'Big brother... don't bully Ria... please...'」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha?! I-I'm not bullying you or anything...」

name: Ria
message: 「If you fall for a trick like that, you've still got a long way to go\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem! A true big sister is always one step ahead♪」
The fact that she's trying so hard to act like a big sister already feels pretty childish to me, though.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on. You're supposed to be carrying this, aren't you」

name: Misa
message: 「The Blackuma keychain is...\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This place is a veritable treasure trove~. My curiosity is thoroughly piqued, yes it is~」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, that's merchandise, so you can't touch it」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Hmm~~. Well, I did do Ria-chan wrong earlier. Take it along with you, you little thieves」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... are you sure?」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Yeah, don't sweat it. Call it an apology and let me off the hook」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, no... please don't worry about it」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Hahaha. Bringing up a woman's age is just poking a hornet's nest, huh. I'll keep that in mind.」

name: Ria
message: 「Tamekage-san... Thank you very much!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I wonder if I can carry this much...」

name: Ria
message: 「'Do your best, Big Brother with a million horsepower\s04'」
I really am no match for Senpai.
